_description: Pre-made test data for CoachingStudio sync validation
_usage: Use these test clients/sessions for Dimanche scenarios. Modify values in CoachingStudio UI instead of pasting.

device_1.action: Click 'Nouveau Client' → Fill: Prenom='TestSync', Email='test@example.com' → Click 'Créer'
device_1.check: Client appears in list on Device 1

Scenario_1_Create.success_criteria: Client visible on both devices within 1 second of creation

device_1.action: Open TestSync client → Change prenom to 'TestSync2' → Save

Scenario_2_Modify.success_criteria: Modification appears on both devices within 1 second

Scenario_3_Offline.step: Create client while offline, then reconnect

device_1.step_6: Wait 5 seconds — client should sync silently

Scenario_3_Offline.success_criteria: No errors offline, auto-sync on reconnect, appears on other device

Scenario_4_Delete.success_criteria: Deletion propagates to both devices within 1 second

Check_Console.Look_For: Zero red error messages (⚠️ warnings are OK)
Check_Console.Expected: Only blue info messages or no messages at all
Check_Console.If_Red_Error: Screenshot + Copy error text → Send to Claude

Check_localStorage.How: Open DevTools (F12) → Application → Local Storage → https://coachingstudio.vercel.app
Check_localStorage.Value: Should contain JSON with your test data
Check_localStorage.If_Empty: Sync may not be writing to cache (error)

Check_Firestore.If_Missing: saveClient() not firing or Firestore error

Issue_1.problem: Client created on Device 1 but not appearing on Device 2 after 5+ seconds
Issue_1.fix: Check Firebase Console → Firestore → Indexes → Both must be GREEN
Issue_1.if_not_green: Run 'firebase firestore:indexes:list' and wait for indexes to build (can take 5-10 min)

Issue_2.fix: Same as Issue 1 — create the 2 indexes

Issue_3.problem: Client created offline but doesn't sync after reconnect
Issue_3.fix: Check Firestore Rules — might have wrong permissions

Issue_4.problem: Data syncing but very slowly (5-10+ seconds)
Issue_4.likely_cause: Network latency or Firestore indexes still building
Issue_4.fix: Wait 5 more minutes for indexes to fully enable

_notes: Replace [YOUR_COACH_UID_HERE] with your actual Firebase UID
Test data is optional — you can create clients manually in the UI
The validation script (validate-sync.js) doesn't need this data — it just checks the code
For multi-device testing, use REAL devices (iPhone + Desktop) or DevTools Device Emulator
